title: Everyday usability and ease of use
summary: Feedback centers on strong everyday usability, with praise for easy handling, comfort, fuel economy, and practical performance, while several fragments are too vague to classify beyond general approval.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car’s everyday usability alongside easy handling, ride comfort, fuel economy, practical speed, safety, and current tech.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews express broad satisfaction or mention usability without enough concrete detail to classify specific aspects confidently.

limitations: The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all owners.
One positive fragment focuses on dealer response rather than vehicle usability, which makes the topic slightly mixed in subject matter.
Several undetermined fragments are too brief or vague to support more specific aspect-level conclusions.
